Docgen Component Gallery

REF-401 · doc-system · draft · 2026-08-22
🛡PUBLIC

overview

Every component the document design system ships, exercised once — this page is both the visual test of the rendered stylesheet and the author's reference for what Markdown turns into. Build it with python3 -m tools.docgen.cli build tools/docgen/gallery.md.

Typography and prose

Body text is the humanist sans at 16px/1.6, capped near a 46em measure. Inline code gets the mono voice with a soft chip. Links look like this internal reference. Bold carries weight-700; headings track tight.

An h3 subsection

h3 is a prose subheading. The h4 below is the mono "system voice" label:

System-voice label (h4)

Ordinary paragraphs continue underneath.

Wide tables scroll inside their own container — the page never scrolls sideways.

Notes and callouts

A plain blockquote in body Markdown renders as the standard ink note. Use it for constraints, warnings, and "read this first" context.

<div class="note brand"><span class="lab">Brand-critical note</span> The <code>.brand</code> variant carries the one accent this page is allowed. Reserve it for the single thing the reader must not miss.</div>

Steps (procedures with in/out lines)

<ol class="steps"> <li><strong>Author the Markdown</strong> with YAML front matter, an h1, and prose. <span class="io">in: conventions · out: a compliant .md source</span></li> <li><strong>Build</strong> with <code>python3 -m tools.docgen.cli build FILE.md</code>. <span class="io">in: .md · out: self-contained .html in the output directory</span></li> <li><strong>Verify</strong> with <code>cli check</code> in the docs session gate before shipping. <span class="io">in: .md · out: OK / FAIL with reasons</span></li> </ol>

python3 -m tools.docgen.cli build tools/docgen/gallery.md -o .docgen/gallery
